ceremony_rule: verify every rostered contribution before graph funding; any invalid proof or abort invalidates the epoch and restarts with fresh setup scalars

program_inventory.execution_class: one-time setup proof; never evaluated by the conditional lock

remaining_engineering: select and pin the public proof verifier
bind proof-system version and program digest into the ceremony manifest
benchmark setup proof generation and verification
security_effect: malicious contributors cannot substitute an unlock-dead fault key without breaking proof soundness
one honest contributor keeps the aggregate pre-witness signing scalar hidden
all accepted contributors remain necessary for liveness in the n-of-n variant
